Here is a generated column description for the column **LISTING_STATUS** in the **RENTAL_INFORMATION** table:

---

### Column Description

| Attribute | Details |
|---|---|
| **Column Name** | LISTING_STATUS |
| **Table Name** | RENTAL_INFORMATION |
| **Data Type** | VARCHAR / STRING |
| **Nullable** | No |
| **Description** | Indicates the **current status of a rental property listing**. This column reflects whether a rental listing is actively available, temporarily unavailable, or has been closed/rented out. It is used to track and manage the lifecycle of rental property listings. |

---

### Possible Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| **ACTIVE** | The rental listing is currently available and open for inquiries or applications. |
| **INACTIVE** | The rental listing has been temporarily deactivated or put on hold. |
| **PENDING** | The rental listing is under review or awaiting approval before being published. |
| **RENTED** | The property has been successfully rented out and is no longer available. |
| **EXPIRED** | The rental listing has passed its expiration date and is no longer valid. |
| **CANCELLED** | The rental listing has been withdrawn or cancelled by the owner or manager. |

---

### Additional Notes

- This column is commonly used for **filtering and reporting** purposes to identify available versus unavailable rental properties.
- The status should be **updated in real-time** or near real-time to ensure accurate availability information.
- This column may be used in conjunction with **LISTING_START_DATE** and **LISTING_END_DATE** columns to manage listing validity periods.

---
